the use of village based geographic-spatials data display of health facility DHF data has been used by health center managers as the basis of health promotion actions to the village community.

1) The data of health facility is the early warning system of disease process at the population; 2) The data of puskesmas is the evidence for public health actions; 3) The puskesmas manager has an important role to translate health facility data into the public health action.
village based spatial data can be used as the basis for health promotion action.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the ability of health care managers to link health facility and population level data.
the use of health facility data to raise public awareness of the health problems at the community level.
the ability of health care providers and public health managers to work together and use the data for public health action.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the village based information display of the health facility data can be a simple but powerful tool for public health action.
health facility data are the basis for public health action at the population level.
the village based spatial display of health facility information is a simple and easy way to raise public awareness and to promote community action in prevention of local diseases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the health center managers can use the health facility data to promote the public health actions at the population.
the health center manager has a role in the management of DHF at the population level by using health facility data and information system.
health facility data can be a trigger to raise public awareness and to push the community to get involved to prevent DHF.

the village community is not aware of the problems unless patients from their areas come to the health facility.
